name: @tria/boundary-fixture
description: MOD-02 NEGATIVE FIXTURE — a module-tagged package that breaks every boundary on purpose. It must FAIL `turbo boundaries` and Biome; `pnpm boundaries:negative` (scripts/check-boundaries.sh) asserts exactly that. `@tria/module-feed` is DECLARED here on purpose (04-10): a `module` depending on another `module` is itself forbidden by turbo.json's tag allowlist, and the import reaches a path the feed package never published in its `exports` — the truthful shape of reaching into another module's internals. It declares no lint/typecheck/build/test script, so `turbo run …` never picks it up.
